leftEvidence.role: The mountain and those called blessed
leftEvidence.title: Salt, light, and visible works

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus calls the hearers the earth’s salt and the world’s light, warning about salt that loses its function and light that is hidden.
points.right: Jesus warns against doing merciful deeds before people in order to be seen.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Their light is to shine so people see good works and glorify the Father.
points.right: Public reward is contrasted with hidden giving and the Father who sees in secret.

payload.posture: Good works are to be visible while merciful deeds are not to be performed for visibility.

rightEvidence.role: The Father who sees in secret
rightEvidence.title: Giving is tested by its audience

payload.tension: The difference turns on whom the action glorifies and why it is seen.
payload.title: Visible works and hidden practice
